definitions.explanation: A connection or relationship determined by fate.
A tie or relationship between people.

examples.japanese: {縁|えん}があって{出会|であ}った。

notes:
{縁|えん} refers to fateful connections.

EXPRESSIONS:
- {縁|えん}がある: to be fated/connected
- {縁|えん}がない: to have no connection
- {縁|えん}を{結|むす}ぶ: to form a bond

COMPOUNDS:
- {縁談|えんだん}: marriage proposal
- {縁起|えんぎ}: omen, luck
- {無縁|むえん}: unrelated

NOTE:
Also read as {縁|ふち} meaning edge or rim.
